about_the_game:
Grow a mini forest that keeps you company while you work, study, or play. Drop the window anywhere, resize it to fit, and watch leaves sway as soft audio drifts through your room. Simple, soothing, and light on your PC.

Why ?

  • Chill trees : Trees sprout, sway, and shed on their own. No clicks required.

  • Regrow Anytime : Resprout the grove whenever you want.

  • Recolor : Shift from spring greens to flaming fall reds or wild neon pixels in seconds.

  • 2 Art styles : Nostalgic psx pixels or hand drawn noir!

  • Pick any View : Close up, wide panoramas, find the shot that feels right.

  • Gentle Audio : Hours of calm music with birds, wind, and gentle nature sounds. Mute or mix.

Launch Desktop Forest and let nature keep you company all day!

name: Desktop Forest

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU @ 2.0 GHz (Intel i3 / AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with DirectX 10 / OpenGL 3.3 support (e.g. Intel HD 4000 or newer, AMD Vega iGPU)
  • Storage: 650 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Runs in a small resizable window and sips both CPU and GPU. Works fine on laptops and low-power desktops.

short_description: Desktop Forest turns any corner of your screen into a living woodland. Regrow, recolor, and relax to hours of calm music and gentle nature sounds.
